course_name_en: Modelling and Simulation of Mechatronic Systems
prerequisites: In-depth knowledge of control engineering, automation engineering, mathematics and basic knowledge of numerical mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Students grasp and understand more complex, computer-aided methods for modeling complex technical processes and can interpret the results. They can analyze the simulation methodology and critically evaluate its limits and statements. The validation of the created models is also addressed.
Students can apply a range of specialized, advanced, and state-of-the-art simulation methodologies to concrete problems.

syllabus_topics: Exemplary: Application of simulation tools in the practice of technical development
assessment_rules: Graded examination performance is a project report (oral), lasting approximately 15-30 minutes. Ungraded examination performance is an experimental work, consisting of approximately 6 experiments in total.
